lead: The best software doesn't add steps.
punch: It removes the ones nobody wanted to do.
question: Which tedious task would you gladly hand over to software?
instagram_caption:
Daily Tech Talk #20 💡

The best software doesn't add steps. It removes the ones nobody wanted to do.

Every tool we build starts with a simple goal: finding what your team does by hand every day that they wish they didn't have to touch.

Copying data between tabs. Chasing missing info. Building the exact same spreadsheet every single week.

Which tedious task would you gladly hand over to software? Tell us in the comments 👇

linkedin_post:
"The best software doesn't add steps. It removes the ones nobody wanted to do."

We see this mistake often when teams adopt new tools. They add dashboards, extra approval rounds, and mandatory fields that slow everyone down.

Great software does the opposite. It quietly handles the friction in the background so your team can focus on actual work.

Before you buy your next tool, ask one question: does this remove friction, or just add a new tab to look at?

Which tedious task would you gladly hand over to software?
